A unit built under the Halloween Plan, a Gespenst upgrade program. Rather than overhauling it like Alteisen or the Gespenst Type-RV, this field-minded upgrade refines the mass-production Gespenst Mk-II for versatility and maintainability. It runs on a new Plasma Generator, and a back-mounted Tesla Drive lets it fly alone. It has improved sensors and hardpoints across the frame. This second early-production unit belongs to Major Albero Est, leader of the Cry Wolves, 3rd Special Ops PT Unit. Unlike Kai's unit, it has a Plasma Buckler only on the left arm, but carries a large F2W (Folding Two-Way) Cannon.

A unit built under the Halloween Plan, a Gespenst upgrade program. Rather than overhauling it like Alteisen or the Gespenst Type-RV, this field-minded upgrade refines the mass-production Gespenst Mk-II for versatility and maintainability. It runs on a new Plasma Generator, and a back-mounted Tesla Drive lets it fly alone. It has improved sensors and hardpoints across the frame. This first early-production unit belongs to Major Kai Kitamura of the Tactical Instructor Corps. Plasma Bucklers on both arms give it strong melee ability.

A unit built under the Halloween Plan, a Gespenst upgrade program. Rather than overhauling it like Alteisen or the Gespenst Type-RV, this field-minded upgrade refines the mass-production Gespenst Mk-II for versatility and maintainability. It runs on a new Plasma Generator, and a back-mounted Tesla Drive lets it fly alone. It has improved sensors and hardpoints across the frame. This third early-production unit is for Warrant Officer Hugo Medio of the Cry Wolves, 3rd Special Ops PT Unit. Unlike Kai's unit, it has a Plasma Buckler only on the left arm, but carries a large F2W (Folding Two-Way) Cannon.
Mass-produced Valsion, after DC leader Bian Zoldark's machine. Nearly as capable as the original, it isn't one of the seven early units; Shu likely built it by some means.

Vice Commander of the <DC>. A cunning old man and gifted scientist. Bian's right hand in commanding the DC, he secretly aims to conquer and rule the world with his own unmanned weapons. Developing advanced combat AI, he recruited Tenzan, Ryoto and others into the DC as sample data. He once ran <The School>. Age 70.

Levi's aide, in effect. A cruel, cunning woman who scorns Earthlings as savages. Her psychic telekinesis lets her read and manipulate others' memories and emotions, so foes face their own traumas and falter.

Test pilot and leader of the SRX Team. A telekinetic, she aided her father's research as a test subject at the Japan Special Brain Medical Institute before enlisting. She joined the military when the <SRX Project> began and worked on the <T-LINK System>. Responsible and caring, she seems feisty, but is a gentle soul who dislikes fighting. Age 21, rank Captain.

Earth Federation Government official on the <EOT Special Council>. Carl Stresemann's confidant and public political face. He looks tough and capable, but is a timid puppet of Carl. Earth's envoy at the Antarctic talks. Age 52.

A cunning <DC> scientist whose true intentions are unreadable. At the <Earth Cradle>, he analyzes Aerogator materials and uses the data to develop metal cells called Machine Cells. Backed by Adler, he is also developing the <Game System>.

<Personal Trooper> pilot at the Earth Federation Army's Far East Branch, Izu Base. Cultured and smooth, a womanizer whose targets span all ages. Formerly of the special PTX Team; a first-rate pilot. He sees the big picture and uses ruthless means if needed. His father is Jonathan Kazahara, a <Tesla Reich Institute> leader and co-creator of the Super Fighter Grungust. Age 28, rank Lieutenant.

Commander of the SRX Team and key figure of the <SRX Project>. A leading <EOT> analyst and a skilled pilot. Always cool, yet strangely unfathomable. He once led the PTX Team, a special <Personal Trooper> unit, but his pre-military past is unknown. Age unknown, rank Major.

A secret Aerogator agent. His main tasks: gathering intel on Earth and finding and raising humans with special powers like telekinesis. He deliberately gives Earth <EOT> such as the <Tronium> Engine to "evolve" humans into superior weapons. He sees Ryusei, Aya and the others as mere test subjects, and coldly sacrifices others for his ends. In Neviim he is called "Aureph Balshem," for unknown reasons.

A <Mao Industries> staff member. An intelligent, composed woman. Taciturn and seemingly cold, she simply shows no more emotion than needed. An infiltration expert who also serves as a <Personal Trooper> test pilot. At <Mao Industries> she helped develop the R-GUN and Hückebein Mk-II. Age and past unknown.

Bridge operator of the Hagane, second Space Noah-class battleship. Handles sensors. Skilled, but flippant and given to one remark too many. Formerly on the Shirogane's bridge, he joined the Hagane on Tetsuya's recommendation. Age 20, rank Corporal.

An ATX Team test pilot. Cool and smart at heart, though her showiness and flippant talk hide it from others. She resents Kyosuke's curt treatment, but loves him more than anyone. A skilled pilot, best at high-mobility and ranged combat. A heavy drinker who enjoys watching the drunks around her. Age 23, rank Second Lieutenant.

A combat commander seconded from the <United Colony Corps> to the <DC>. Eldest son of the distinguished military family Branstein, and Raidiese's older brother. Calm, proud and devoted to the greater cause. An original member of the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, he is a genius pilot of both <Personal Trooper>s and <Armored Module>s. He is also a flexible thinker who always acts with the bigger picture in mind. His hobby is horseback riding, and he calls any machine he pilots "Trombe" (German for "tornado") after his beloved horse. A true gourmet, he is also an excellent cook. He was married to Katraia, who has since passed away. Age 29. Rank: Major.

A key member of the <SRX Project>. A brilliant engineer and one of the fathers of the <Personal Trooper>, he heads <PT> development at <Mao Industries>, though he is currently seconded to the Far East Branch. A cold perfectionist, yet he somehow gets along with Robert, his polar opposite. Age 32.

A pilot stationed at the Earth Federation Army's Far East Branch, Izu Base. A cheerful, easygoing woman who can be careless and sloppy, jumps to conclusions, acts rashly and never sweats the details. She loves putting makeup and daring outfits on younger girls, especially Latune. Age 23. Rank: Sergeant Major.

Vice-chairman of the Earth Federation Government's Security Committee and chairman of the <EOT Special Council>. A conservative politician and the most powerful man in the Federation Government, he prefers pulling strings from the shadows to acting openly. He showed real foresight in forming the EOT Special Council to keep secrets the moment he learned <EOT> had been found in <Meteor 3>. Once the study of Meteor 3 and EOT revealed how powerful the Aerogators were, he saw Bian and Maier, who called for all-out resistance, as dangerous, and monitored and obstructed them. Age 75.

Captain of the Personal Trooper unit at the Earth Federation Army's Far East Branch, Izu Base. A veteran of the Federation's <Tactical Instructor Corps>, which created the base data for the <TC-OS>, he is a highly skilled pilot. A soldier who rose through the ranks and believes in leading from the field, he is feared by his subordinates as a demon captain. Age 36. Rank: Major.

A pilot assigned to the Hiryu-class multipurpose battleship Hiryu Custom and leader of Octopus Squadron (Octo Team). A hot-blooded, headstrong and combative woman who acts before she thinks, talks harshly and has broken orders many times. Still, her piloting is solid, and she surprisingly looks after her subordinates. She hopes to become a test pilot for prototype machines. Age 25. Rank: Lieutenant.

An Aerogator warrior. Fatally injured in a past accident, most of his body has been mechanized. He has next to no personality or emotion and is extremely taciturn. A superb pilot, he carries out his missions in a literally mechanical way.

A test pilot on the ATX Team. His silence makes him seem cool, but he simply hides his feelings; deep down he burns with quiet passion. A gambler who gets fired up the worse the odds are. He and Excellen are lovers, and though he rarely shows it, he cherishes her above all else. Age 22. Rank: Second Lieutenant (later Lieutenant).

An officer of the Earth Federation Army's Intelligence Division. Calm, composed and sharp-witted, with something mysterious about him, yet he has a soft spot for duty and compassion. A veteran of the Federation's <Tactical Instructor Corps>, which created the base data for the <TC-OS>, he is a top-class Personal Trooper pilot. Age 27 (self-reported). Rank: Major.

Ryusei's high school classmate. Kind and gentle, yet capable of remarkable action when it counts. A health-gadget fanatic who loves baths, she dreams of becoming a nurse. She later boards the Space Noah-class multipurpose battleship No. 2, the Hagane, as a medic.

Commander of the Earth Federation Army's North American Branch, Langley Base. Bold and full of grit. He looks intimidating but is usually mild and understanding toward his subordinates. Like Laker of the Far East Branch, he backed the <Earth Sphere Defense Plan> launched by Norman Slay of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and started the <ATX Project> at Langley Base. Age 55. Rank: Major General.

Masaki's familiar. A spirit formed from a piece of his subconscious; she doesn't resemble him in personality because she is one of his personas. She rides in the Cybuster with Masaki and supports him. Fairly laid-back, but more of a worrier, she often scolds the reckless Shiro and Masaki.

An Aerogator warrior. An arrogant, cruel man who treats combat like a game and takes the greatest pleasure in wiping out Earthlings. Like Galuin, he was badly injured in a past accident, and part of his body has been mechanized.

A key member of the <SRX Project>. Developer of the T-LINK System and Aya's father. Once notorious as a maverick of brain medicine, he made "restoring humanity's latent ESP" his life's work at the Japan Special Brain Medicine Institute. Taciturn, he dislikes dealing with people. Age 49.

Vice-commander of the Earth Federation Army's Far East Branch, Izu Base. Laker's right hand and a capable strategist. A nervous realist who can be inflexible, but only because he wants to keep losses to a minimum and his subordinates safe. Age 40. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel.

A combat commander of the <United Colony Corps>. A man willing to use dirty tricks to advance his career. He shifts his stance depending on who he faces and ruthlessly attacks the weak. A schemer, but careless with the details. Age 33. Rank: Major.

A pilot stationed at the Earth Federation Army's Far East Branch, Izu Base. Cheerful and flashy. He looks wild but is easygoing. A pilot who rose from the field, he has plenty of experience and loves music more than anything. He is Garnet's boyfriend, but in private she has him wrapped around her finger. Age 26. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

Princess of the Principality of Riksent, a special Federation autonomous region on the Mediterranean. Innocent, endlessly curious and quick to act on a whim. She is close friends with Latune and has a crush on Raidiese. She also has the power of foresight. Age 12.

A genius scientist who holds about ten doctorates despite his youth. A cool, handsome man with a shadowy air, calm and composed, and supremely self-confident. He loathes being used and never forgives anyone who uses him. Under Dr. Bian Zoldark of the <EOTI Institute>, he handled the Granzon's basic design and special equipment, and serves as its test pilot himself. His true identity and past are unknown. Age 22.
Guardian to Shine, princess of the Principality of Riksent. Though the tomboyish Shine is a handful, he keeps watching over her, sometimes nagging, sometimes warm. Age 64.

XO of the Hiryu-class battleship Hiryu Custom. A gentle English gentleman whose knowledge, experience and humor make him Lefina's able support. Once XO of the explorer Hiryu under Daitetsu. Slated to replace Daitetsu after he was relieved over the Hiryu's damage, he declined and recommended Lefina. A heavy drinker like Daitetsu and a liquor buff. Age 55, Major.

A scientist at the <Tesla Reich Institute>. Irm's father and Robert's former boss. An authority on robotics whose talent rivals Bian Zoldark's. Yet he's easygoing, loves jokes and women. He also created the Grungust series. Age 54.

Masaki's familiar, split off from part of his unconscious. It differs from him because it's one of his personas. Rides in Cybuster to support him. Fairly laid-back, yet competitive and always has one word too many.

Leader of the ATX Team. A bold warrior who stays true to his beliefs. He values honor and strives to act fairly, but can be inflexible. An expert in melee, especially swordplay; his Grungust Type 0 and its Zankanto are feared by friend and foe. A former member of the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, where he became close friends with Elzam V. Branstein. Age 29, Major.

A <DC> scientist. A member of Project Ark (a species preservation plan) and developer of Magus, the <Earth Cradle>'s control computer. A rational realist whose beauty adds to an aloof air, but she has a kind, caring heart.

Captain of the Hagane, second Space Noah-class battleship. A decisive, battle-hardened veteran, the picture of a no-nonsense man, with fine command skills and vast experience. He once captained the Hiryu. That record won him command of the first ship, Shirogane, but Granzon's rebellion left it wrecked. His fighting spirit unbroken, he took over the Hagane from Laker to take on the DC. A smoker and heavy drinker. Age 56, Lieutenant Colonel.

Hiryu Custom mechanic. A carefree optimist and self-styled gambler, always testing his luck. Flippant but quick-witted and perceptive. Deft with his hands and at magic tricks, yet hopeless at sports. Age 18, Corporal (later 2nd Lieutenant).

XO of the Space Noah-class ship Hagane. Recognized and promoted to XO by Daitetsu, he respects him deeply. Honest and capable, but sometimes struggles with the gap between his inexperience and the weight of the post. Close in age to the crew, he has their trust. Age 29, Captain.

A <DC> pilot. An arrogant man who enjoys fighting like a game, seeing lives as mere game pieces and readily carrying out plans that sacrifice allies. He adapts extremely well to mobile weapons, quickly pushing any machine beyond its specs. Like Ryusei, he was scouted by the DC for his Burning PT skills. Age 21. No rank, but treated as a Captain.

A <United Colony Corps> commander seconded to the <DC>. A taciturn career soldier with a fierce temper. Ex-member of the <Tactical Instructor Corps> and the <DC>'s top ace. Lost his wife and daughter in the Hope Incident 16 years ago, and loathes the Federation for botching it. Age 39, Major.
A <DC> combat commander. Shrewd and sharp. Affable on the surface, he hides a calculating mind. A total individualist, indifferent to others' fate. Age 32. Rank: Major.
Mysterious man in contact with <EOT Special Council> chair Carl Stresemann. His past is unclear.

Federation Army Joint Staff officer. A general known as its sharpest mind, he saw the Aerogator threat early and formed the Earth Sphere Defense Committee. His Earth Sphere Defense Plan began the Hagane and other Space Noah-class ships and anti-Aerogator programs like the <ATX Project> and <SRX Project>. Age 59, Major General.

Combat commander at Izu Base. A cunning elitist focused on his own career and safety. Resents Laker for backing the <Earth Sphere Defense Plan> and mistreats defiant subordinates like Irm and Kyosuke. Age 38, Lieutenant Colonel.

A genius robotics scientist and leader of the <DC>. A realist who will stop at nothing, and an idealist with a romantic side. Both rational and emotional, with great charisma. Fearing an alien invasion even before Meteor 3 fell, Bian spent his fortune founding the <Tesla Reich Institute>. After the fall of <Meteor 3>, he headed the <EOTI Institute>, which analyzed its overtechnology. He later formed the military group Divine Crusaders (DC) from it and declared war on the Earth Federation Government. Age 44.

President of the Colony Union governing 10 space colonies. A capable pacifist politician respected even in the Earth Federation Government. Once led the autonomy movement (NID4). Despite sabotage by Carl Streissman's anti-colony faction, he won independence and became the Union's first president.

ATX Team test pilot, called Bullet. An earnest, warmhearted young man who hates injustice. Often swept along by the reckless Kyosuke and Excellen. Gifted with Telekinesis, a special mental power, he pilots <T-LINK System> units. Age 18, Second Lieutenant.

Commander-in-chief of the <United Colony Corps>. Head of the Branstein family, a noble colony military clan, and father of Raidiese and Elzam. A dignified, stoic man devoted to a greater cause. His lineage and character draw many followers in the Corps, yet he stays humble. Fearing the Aerogator threat and Federation corruption, he joins Bian's <DC> revolt. Age 57.

Operator of Cybuster, the Wind Masou Kishin. Impulsive, just and athletic, but has a terrible sense of direction. Age 17. A Japanese youth summoned to Langran, a holy kingdom in the underground world La Gias, he became Cybuster's operator to stop a prophesied demon's calamity. Shu Shirakawa, tied to La Gias, had the capital destroyed, and Masaki lost his benefactor. Fearing Shu and Granzon would bring calamity to the surface too, he pursued Shu with Cybuster and met him by chance in Antarctica.

Central figure of the <ATX Project>. A gifted scientist, but a jealous workaholic hungry for recognition. Formerly at <Mao Industries>, she worked on the Gespenst under Kirk Hamill, but quit, unhappy her talent went unrecognized. She then joined the Federation Army's ATX Project in North America, creating Alteisen and Weissritter. Age 30.

A <Mao Industries> executive and Rio's father. He co-founded the firm with Ling's father and is now her right hand. Overprotective, he constantly frets over his daughter, who enlisted against his will. Age 53.

Leader of the Troye, the <United Colony Corps> Royal Guard. A proud warrior who scorns cowardly tricks and prefers fair fights (and operations). She leads the Troye, finest of the elite Colony Corps, and is one of its top aces. Age 25, Major.
Ryusei's mother. Easygoing in look but strong at heart, she raised him alone after his father died. Yet her past and abilities will greatly change her son's future. Age 36.
Bridge operator on the Hiryu-class battleship Hiryu Custom. Earnest, a bit of a neat freak, but friendly. Lefina's space academy classmate, she always watches over her. Age 20, Corporal.

A <Mao Industries> staffer. A thoughtful, quiet woman with telepathic powers, she helped develop man-machine interfaces there. A yoga expert, she's somewhat feared for pushing tough asanas (yoga poses) on others. Age 27.

An SRX Team test pilot from the Brancstein military dynasty. Calm and highly skilled, but his nature is the opposite of Ryusei's, so they often clash. He lost his left hand in a Hückebein runaway accident. Colony Corps commander Maier is his father and its top ace Elzam his brother, but they are estranged for now. Age 19, Second Lieutenant.

A pilot on the Hiryu-class Hiryu Custom, directly under Katina. Gentle and quiet, he worries for the reckless Katina and reins her in. On and off duty he supports others, an unsung hero. Age 20, Master Sergeant.

A pilot at Izu Base, Federation Army Far East Branch. From <The School>, she excels at piloting Personal Troopers in combat. Taciturn and reserved, she fears people due to the School's harsh experiments and training. Careless about makeup and clothes, she usually wears analyzer glasses. Age 14, Master Sergeant.

Bridge operator of the Hagane, the second Space Noah-class battleship. A cheerful, earnest girl with a strong sense of justice. Competitive, she states her views firmly, but can admit it when shown she's wrong. Her father is a Mao Industries executive; she enlisted over her parents' objections. Age 18, Corporal.

Adviser to the <Tesla Reich Institute>. A Jigen-ryu master, he helped design Grungust swords and their motion data. Teacher of Sänger and Bullet. Strict about the sword, but a kindly old man otherwise. Age 66.

An SRX Team test pilot. Spotted by Major Ingram Plissken, key figure of the <SRX Project>, he was scouted to test the R-1. Hot-blooded and reckless, he charges headlong. Through many trials he finds his reason to fight and grows as a warrior. A huge robot anime fan, he adores super robots. Age 18, Master Sergeant (later Second Lieutenant).

Only daughter of <DC> leader Bian Zoldark. Superhuman athleticism, reflexes and visual acuity. A beauty, but a wild tomboy, weak to flattery. Meant to be the Valsion's official pilot, the spoiled girl instead had her own robot, the "Valsione," built. She loves Japanese period dramas, the more obscure the better. Hobby: saving money. Age 16.

A shy, kind-hearted boy. He tends to see things pessimistically and is somewhat poor at expressing his feelings, which he hates about himself. He was originally a <DC> Armored Module pilot, but an incident led him to join the Hagane. Age 18.

<United Colony Corps> staff officer and Maier's right hand. Promoted young by Maier, who saw great talent, and utterly devoted to him. One of few who grasp Maier's heart and true goals. Age 24, Lieutenant Colonel.

President of <Mao Industries>, the Personal Trooper maker. Cool and pragmatic. Influenced by her father, the company's founder, she trained as a <Personal Trooper> pilot and once served in the Federation Far East Branch's special unit, the "PTX Team." Age 28.

Commander of Izu Base, Far East Branch. Gentle and personable, a small, mild-faced old man who seems a harmless idler, he was once a famed strategist at Federation Joint Staff. Dismayed by the rot in the top brass, he backed Major General Norman Slay and joined the <Earth Sphere Defense Plan>, launching the <SRX Project>. Age 58, Brigadier General.

A Troye Unit pilot of the <United Colony Corps>. Of the Garstein family, a Brancstein branch; cousin to Rai and Elzam. Cool, proud and strong-willed. Aloof, but always straining to measure up, she's secretly weak to sympathy. She seems good at everything, but can't cook. Age 18, Second Lieutenant.

The Aerogators' leader, gifted with powerful "telekinesis." Also the living core of Judecca, the giant weapon at the heart of the automated planet Nebiim, their base. Girlish in looks but mentally mature. Missing most of her memories, she can at times become unstable.

Captain of the Hiryu Custom. A talent who graduated top of her class at the space academy on Icarus Base in the asteroid belt. Demure, anxious and quick to cry, but strong at heart. Her earnest dedication wins her crew's trust despite her inexperience. Chosen as captain on Sean's recommendation, she grows into the role with his help. Age 19, rank Commander.
Head of Isurugi Heavy Industries. A ruthless profiteer, influential through ties to the <EOT Special Council>, <DC> and <Earth Federation Army>.

Key member of the <SRX Project>. A cheerful, friendly young robotics genius who grew up idolizing robots. He helped develop the Grungust series at the <Tesla Reich Institute> before joining the <SRX Project> in the Far East. He also created the Burning PT and loves talking robots with Ryusei. Age 27.

Combat commander of the <DC> remnants. Soft-spoken and seemingly refined, but cold and cruel. A former terrorist with no ideology, he worked purely for pay. After the <L5 Campaign>, he joined the DC remnants on someone's recommendation, serving under Van. Age 34, rank Major.

A test pilot of <Project TD>, once run by the <DC> and now under Federation control. Single-minded and strong-willed, she dreams of becoming an astronaut and has endured grueling training to get there. Her skill falls far short of her Project TD comrade Sleigh, ranking her No. 04, but no one can match her passion.
Inspector combat commander. Aggressive and tomboyish, she wears her heart on her sleeve and hates to lose. Pilots the high-speed Silberwind. Age 29, and furious if called old. Sikalog's lover.

Neuroscientist of the <DC> remnants. Since her days at <The School>, she has conditioned Boosted Children like Ouka and Arado, specializing in memory and mind control. She treats them as guinea pigs without remorse.

Leader of the <DC> remnants' Special Processing Team. A superb pilot and martial artist, cool outside but hot-blooded within. He has some unexplained history with Kyosuke Nanbu and is obsessed with settling it in battle. He calls the Alteisen by its rejected name, Gespenst Mk-III.

A test pilot who leads the SRX Team. Gifted with Telekinesis, she was a test subject for her father at the Japan Special Brain Institute before enlisting. With the <SRX Project>'s launch she joined the military, helping develop the <T-LINK System>. Responsible and caring; outwardly tough, but a gentle woman who dislikes fighting. Rank Captain.
A <DC> remnant soldier raised in <The School>. Cheerful and breezy, but earnest at heart. After the School closed, he kept training as a <DC> mech pilot, always at the bottom of the class.

The only one of the mysterious Einst with a near-human form. She pilots the humanoid weapon Person-Lichkeit to approach Kyosuke and the others. Her looks and voice resemble Excellen's, suggesting some link to her and Kyosuke...

Artificial humans built for combat by Dr. Egret Fehu, called Machinery Children. Many Machinery Children share the face of the Originator, Urd (No. 1), on whom they are based. The most outstanding are Thurisaz (No. 2) and Ansuz (No. 3). Ansuz is cruel and cunning.

Scientist of the <Earth Cradle>. At the <DC>, he studied Aerogator unit materials and used the data to develop the metallic cells called Machine Cells. He also created the <Game System>. Now the Cradle's de facto leader, he takes in Van and the DC remnants.

Pilot at the Federation's Izu Base. Well-educated, glib and skilled, and a womanizer who'll flirt with any age. An ex-member of the special PTX Team and a first-rate pilot, he sees the big picture and won't shy from ruthless means. His father, Jonathan Kazahara, is a leader at the <Tesla Reich Institute> and co-creator of the Super Fighter Grungust. Rank Lieutenant.

Inspector combat commander. Hot-headed and belligerent, he sees Earthlings as lower life forms. He loyally pursues supreme commander Wendolo's orders, but sometimes spins his wheels. A skilled pilot, he flies the beast-like machine Galgau.

Head of the SRX Team. Once a double agent for the <Aerogators>. A calm, intelligent woman. Taciturn, she seems cold but just shows no more emotion than needed. An infiltration expert, she also takes part in the <SRX Project>. Age unknown, rank Captain.

Commander of the special forces unit Shadow Mirror. A pure soldier who holds that might makes right, noble in his way, troubled by the world's future, and deeply trusted by his men. Fearing lasting peace will rot the world, he schemes for endless war, where soldiers like him have purpose.

Supreme commander of the Inspectors. Made an alien civilization inspector at just 16. A schemer skilled in politics and command. Ever smiling and gentle, but cold and cruel at heart. Proud, he scorns Earthlings as barbaric lower life forms.
A mysterious man in the <DC> remnants. Quiet, but a demon in battle. He pilots the special mech Thrudgelmir against Kyosuke's group. His words and actions recall a certain someone...

Artificial humans built for combat by Dr. Egret Fehu, called Machinery Children. Many Machinery Children share the face of the Originator, Urd (No. 1), on whom they are based. The most outstanding are Thurisaz (No. 2) and Ansuz (No. 3). Urd is their leader and the most capable, calm and collected.

The Space Noah-class Hagane's bridge operator, in charge of sensors. Skilled, but flippant and always one word too many. <Before the DC War> he crewed the bridge of the first ship, Shirogane, which led Tetsuya to recommend him for the Hagane. Rank: Corporal.
A DC remnant special agent in the special missions unit, and a humanoid mech pilot. A calm, composed woman with a strangely inhuman air. She faithfully obeys the unit's scientist, Lemon Browning.

A test pilot on the ATX Team. At heart she's cool and intelligent, but her self-promotion and flippant chatter hide it. She resents Kyosuke's curt treatment, yet loves him more than anyone. A skilled pilot, best at high-mobility and ranged combat. A heavy drinker who likes watching others get drunk. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

Head of the LTR (Lost Technology Research) special archaeology division, studying the Chokijin of ancient China. Flashy-looking but intelligent and composed. Her passion for research often blinds her to everything else, and she's prone to trouble.

Eldest son of the noble military Branstein family and Raidiese's older brother. Calm, proud, and devoted to a greater cause. A founding member of the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, he is a genius at piloting <Personal Trooper>s and <Armored Module>s. A flexible thinker, he always keeps the big picture in view. A keen rider, he names his machines Trombe (German for "tornado") after his beloved horse. A gourmet and a superb cook. He lost his wife, Katraia. Also known as Rätsel Feinschmecker.

A <DC> remnant pilot from <The School>. She had the best combat and piloting skills in the School, and as the eldest, Arado, Seolla, Latune and the others saw her as a big sister. Gentle in manner but cold, she opens up only to Arado and others from the School.
A key <SRX Project> member and brilliant engineer, one of the fathers of the <Personal Trooper>. A cold perfectionist who oddly gets along with his opposite, Robert. Once married to Marion.

Cheerful and easygoing, if sloppy, hasty and a little rash; she never sweats the details. She loves putting younger girls, Latune above all, in makeup and bold outfits. After the <L5 Campaign> she left the army and married Giada.

A <DC> remnant pilot, known as Carla. Tomboyish and passionate, an optimist who forgets small worries after a night's sleep. In her hometown, San Diego, she trained to sing and dance for show business, but lost her family to the <Aerogators>. Rescued by Yuuki, she joined the DC remnants to avenge them. Age 18, Second Lieutenant.

Leader of the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, re-formed after the <L5 Campaign>. A field-first soldier risen from the ranks. Once feared as a demon, he's mellowed since. He and Latune's team make motion data and test new machines. Rank: Major.

Hiryu Custom pilot leading Octopus Squadron (Octo Team). Hot-blooded and combative, she acts before thinking, talks tough and often defies orders. Yet she's skilled and surprisingly caring to her subordinates. Rank: First Lieutenant.

Wife of Elzam V. Branstein, half Japanese and half German, from Kyoto. Strong-willed yet kind and gentle. Elzam fell for her for three reasons: her good nature, her cooking (better than his), and his beloved horse Trombe letting her ride it. She died in a terrorist attack on the space colony <Elpis> in New Century 184.

Leader of the ATX Team. Taciturn and seemingly cool, he just hides his feelings, burning quietly within. A gambler who thrives on long-odds bets. Excellen's lover; he rarely shows it, but treasures her above all. Rank: First Lieutenant.

An officer of the Earth Federation Army's Intelligence Division. Calm, composed and sharp-witted, with something mysterious about him, yet he has a soft spot for duty and compassion. A veteran of the Federation's <Tactical Instructor Corps>, which created the base data for the <TC-OS>, he is a top-class Personal Trooper pilot. Age 27 (self-reported). Rank: Major.

A scientist who tunes Boosted Children for Aguila Cemeto. Once researched brainwave control devices in a Federation lab, then went to the <EOTI Institute>, met Aguila and joined <The School>. After the <L5 Campaign>, moved to <Earth Cradle> to tune Arado, Seolla and others.
ATX Team member. Gentle and quiet, yet remarkably decisive when it counts. A health-gadget fanatic who loves baths. A telekinetic, she pilots <T-LINK System> units. She and Bullet are a couple.

Chair of the Earth Federation Government's Security Committee. A hawk urging all-out war on aliens, nicknamed "Wizard" for his looks and backroom skill. His faction has surged since kingmaker Carl Stresemann died in the <L5 Campaign>.

Masaki's familiar. A spirit formed from a piece of his subconscious; she doesn't resemble him in personality because she is one of his personas. She rides in the Cybuster with Masaki and supports him. Fairly laid-back, but more of a worrier, she often scolds the reckless Shiro and Masaki.

Commander of the Federation Army's Langley Base in North America. Power-hungry, he solves problems by force. Obsessed with his own glory, he overworks his men, who dislike him. He sees Laker Randolf, hero of the <DC War> and <L5 Campaign>, as a rival.

A key <SRX Project> member, creator of the T-LINK System and Aya's father. Once a noted maverick of neurology, his life's work at the Japan Special Brain Research Institute was "the recovery of latent human ESP." Taciturn and aloof.
Izu Base vice commander, Laker's right hand and a superb staff officer. A fussy, rigid realist, but only to minimize losses and keep his men safe. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel.
An Inspectors combat commander. Bold but extremely taciturn; few besides his lover Aguija ever hear him speak. Pilots the large humanoid mech Dorukin.
Cheerful, flashy and wild-looking, but easygoing. Loves music. Garnet's boyfriend, but she calls the shots in private. After the <L5 Campaign>, he quit the army and married her.
Princess of the Principality of Riksent, a Federation enclave on the Mediterranean. Innocent, curious, impulsive. Latooni's friend; has a crush on Raidiese. Has Foresight.

A young genius scientist with ten-plus doctorates. Cool, brooding, handsome and supremely confident. Hates being used; never forgives those who use him. He did the Granzon's design and special gear for Dr. Bian Zoldark at the <EOTI Institute>, and is its test pilot. His identity and past are unknown.
Guardian to Princess Shine of the Principality of Riksent. The tomboy is a handful, but he watches over her, stern yet kind.

XO of the Hiryu Custom. A genteel Englishman of deep experience and wit who ably supports Lefina. Formerly XO of the deep-space explorer Hiryu under Daitetsu. Meant to succeed Daitetsu when he was relieved over the Hiryu's damage, he instead recommended Lefina as captain. Drinks hard like Daitetsu; knows his Western spirits. Rank: Lieutenant Commander.

Director of the <Tesla Reich Institute>. Irm's father and Robert's former boss. An authority on robotics whose talent rivals Bian Zoldark's in his prime. Yet he's easygoing, a joker and a womanizer. He also created the Gurungust series.

Masaki's familiar, split off from part of his unconscious. It differs from him because it's one of his personas. Rides in Cybuster to support him. Fairly laid-back, yet competitive and always has one word too many.

Artificial combat humans called Machinery Children, developed by Dr. Egret Fehu. Many are modeled on the originator, Urd (No. 1), and share the same face. The most capable are Thurisaz (No. 2) and Ansuz (No. 3). Thurisaz has a belligerent nature.

A <Project TD> test pilot. Younger sister of project head Filio Presty, whom she adores; she tests the Series 77 to realize his dream. As Number 01, the project's top pilot, she is fierce and merciless toward any foe, supremely confident in her skill and deeply proud.

Like Arado, she's from <The School> and is his partner. A strong-willed, hot-tempered model student. Jumps to conclusions; scary when angry. Yet she's kind at heart, always worried about underachiever Arado.
A bold warrior who stays true to his beliefs. He values honor and fair play, but can be inflexible. An expert in melee, especially swordplay. Rank: Major.

A member of Project Ark (the species preservation plan) and developer of Magus, the <Earth Cradle>'s control computer. A rational realist whose beauty adds to an aloof air, yet she is kind and caring at heart.
Captain of the Hagane, second Space Noah-class ship. A bold, decisive, stoic veteran with superb command skills and vast experience. Smokes and drinks hard. Rank: Commander.

A Hiryu Custom pilot in Katina's Octopus Squad (Octo Team). A carefree optimist and self-styled gambler who loves contests and always tests his luck. Easygoing, but quick-witted and perceptive. Deft with his hands and good at magic tricks, but hopeless at sports. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

Chief of <Project TD>'s system development team. After the <DC>'s fall, she carries on Project TD under Federation military control with Filio, Sleigh and Ibis. She supports Filio at work and in private, and understands him well. Caring, personable and dependable, she can still make coldly rational calls.

XO of the Hagane, second Space Noah-class ship. Daitetsu spotted his talent and made him XO, so he deeply respects the man. Honest and capable, though he sometimes feels too green for so heavy a post. Close in age to the crew, he has their trust. Rank: Lieutenant.
Elzam V. Branstein's beloved horse. Trombe is German for "tornado." Elzam calls every machine he pilots Trombe, which makes this horse the original Trombe.
Picked by President Bryan Midcrid as his aide after the <L5 Campaign>. Well connected in politics and business, but his past is a mystery.

Head of the <DC> remnants. A former liberation fighter, he embraced Bian's ideals and aided him before the DC existed. In the <DC War> he fought in North America; after the DC fell, he hid in the Mexican Plateau. With superb leadership and political skill, he networked hidden DC remnants behind the goal of a new DC, gathering them at the <Earth Cradle> in Africa. Age 48, Colonel.
An Excellence test pilot. Raul's twin sister. Strong-willed and cheerful, and steadier than Raul, she's often mistaken for the older twin. Loves a challenge and won't budge once she's spoken. Age 18.

Head of <Project TD>. A former <DC> roboticist who laid the groundwork for the Lion series. After its fall, he carried on under Federation military control, but it pains him that Series 77 serves military ends. His gentle, earnest nature and talent win him many friends.
Earth Federation President after the <L5 Campaign>. Formerly head of the Colony Union, which governs ten colonies. A capable pacifist politician.

ATX Team test pilot, nicknamed Bullet. An earnest, loyal young man with a strong sense of justice. Often dragged along by the reckless Kyosuke and Excellen. Has an aptitude for Telekinesis and pilots <T-LINK System> units. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

New member of the SRX Team. Aya Kobayashi's sister, on record as killed in an accident. Quiet and gentle, she has no memory of her past. Found after the <L5 Campaign>, she recovered under her father Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi before joining as a trainee.

Pilot of Cybuster, Masou Kishin of wind. Impulsive, just and athletic, but hopelessly bad with directions. A Japanese youth summoned to Langran in the underworld La Gias to pilot Cybuster and stop a prophesied demon god's calamity.
Central figure of the <ATX Project>. A gifted scientist, but a jealous, attention-hungry workaholic. Developer of Alteisen and Weissritter, now building new prototypes at <Mao Industries>.

One of the Exaland's developers. A mechanic who handles all upkeep and new frame design. Earnest and hardworking, yet insecure that mechanics is all she can do. Pained that the Exaland, built for rescue work, is used for war.

President of <Isurugi Heavy Industries>. Daughter of ex-president Renji Isurugi, who died in the <L5 Campaign>. Soft-spoken and gentle-looking, but truly shrewd: profit comes first, by any means and with any partner.
Mercenary who pilots the Shishioh Blade-armed Guarlion Custom "Mumyou." An ace pilot and master swordsman living to "cut" men and machines. Age 45.

Combat commander of the Inspectors and Wendolo's older brother. Rough-spoken but earnest at heart. Coolly reads the battle and will ruthlessly use any means to win. Also chivalrous; he was once wounded shielding Wendolo. His unit, the Greytarkin, was modeled on Earth's humanoid mobile weapons.
An executive of <Mao Industries> and Rio's father. Co-founded the company with Ling's father; now Ling's right hand. An overprotective father, always worried since Rio enlisted against his will.

A pilot of the <DC> remnants. Calm and always gentlemanly. Hates foul play and gladly helps the weak, so he clashes with his superior Archibald. A tea lover, fussy about brewing and drinking it. In the <L5 Campaign>, he fought the Aerogators raiding San Diego and saved Carla, then a civilian. Age 18, Second Lieutenant.
Ryusei's mother. Gentle in appearance but a woman of firm character. She raised Ryusei alone after his father died. Frail and in and out of hospital, she is now recovering at home.
Bridge operator of the Hiryu Custom. Serious and a bit of a neat freak, but personable. A classmate of Lefina's at the space academy, she always watches over her. Rank: Corporal.
Operator for the Time Flow Engine. A young researcher seeking "infinite energy anyone can use." Ignores what bores him but throws himself into what interests him, often blind to all else.
A <Mao Industries> staff member. A thoughtful, quiet telepath who worked on man-machine interfaces there. A yoga expert, she's somewhat feared for urging tough asanas (yoga poses) on others.
SRX Team test pilot. From the Branstein family of noted soldiers. Calm and highly skilled. A bit sardonic, yet loyal and passionate at heart. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

Exaland test pilot. Responsible and hot-blooded, he doesn't fuss over details. His father is Fel, a Time Flow Engine researcher. For years he trained with his twin sister Fiona to become an Exaland test pilot. But keeping Time Flow Engine development alive required military funding, so he set out to finish the engine-powered Exaland and prove its worth. Age 18.
A Hiryu Custom pilot and Katina's direct subordinate. Gentle and quiet, he tries to rein in the reckless Katina. Always backing others up, on duty or off, he's the unsung hero.

A pilot in the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, re-formed after the <L5 Campaign>. From <The School>, she excels at piloting Personal Troopers and combat. Brutal School experiments closed her heart; meeting Ryusei's group restored her humanity.

Angelg's dedicated test pilot. After meeting Kyosuke's group, she joins the ATX Team. A skilled fighter and pilot, calm almost to the point of being mechanical. A smart, quiet beauty with an aloof, inhuman air. Her sharp insight and fixation on intel hint she's searching for something. Oddly, she can't seem to speak politely without fumbling.

New captain of the Shirogane, Space Noah-class ship No. 1. Brilliant and cold, he believes total victory lies in sound theory flawlessly executed. Called "Perfect" at the academy, he graduated first and looks down on classmate Tetsuya, ever the runner-up. Age 29, Commander.

A cheerful, earnest girl with a strong sense of justice. A sore loser, she speaks her mind when sure she's right, yet admits mistakes others point out. Her father Yuan is an executive at <Mao Industries>.
Advisor to the <Tesla Reich Institute>. A Jigen-ryu master, he designs Grungust swords and sword motions, and taught Sänger and Brit. Strict about the sword, but otherwise a kindly old man.
SRX Team test pilot. Hot-blooded, reckless and a super robot fanatic. Childish, yet one of the team's strongest wills, and a psychokinetic. Second Lieutenant.
Only daughter of <DC> leader Bian Zoldark. Superhuman athleticism, reflexes and vision. A beauty, but a wild tomboy who's weak to flattery. Loves obscure Japanese period dramas. Hobby: saving money.
A shy, gentle boy prone to pessimism. He's bad at expressing his feelings and hates himself for it. His love of tinkering with machines led him to help develop a new Personal Trooper.

President of <Mao Industries>, a Personal Trooper maker. Cool-headed and pragmatic. Inspired by her father, the company's founder, she pursued a <Personal Trooper> pilot's career, once serving in the Federation Far East Branch's special PTX Team.
Commander of Izu Base, Far East. Gentle and affable. A small, soft-faced old man who seems sleepy, he was once a famed strategist at Federation Joint Staff HQ.

A mystery man who secretly aids the Hagane and Hiryu Custom. Calm, proud and devoted to a greater cause, yet flexible, always acting with the big picture in view. A genius pilot, he names every machine after his beloved horse Trombe (German for "tornado"). A gourmet and a superb cook.

A Hiryu Custom pilot in Katina's Octopus Team (Octo Squad). Of the Garstein family, a Branstein branch house, she's cousin to Rai and Elzam. Cool, proud and strong-willed, she keeps people at a distance, but always putting on a brave front, she's secretly weak to sympathy. Seemingly good at everything, she can't cook. Second Lieutenant.

Captain of the Hiryu-class Hiryu Custom. She graduated top of her class from the Icarus Base space academy in the asteroid belt. Demure, a worrier and quick to tears, but strong inside. Though new, her earnest dedication has won the crew's trust. Chosen on Sean's recommendation, she grows into a true captain with his support. Commander.

A Federation Special Weapons Research Institute scientist who works with Vindel. Alluring and calm, she treats everything with detachment. She develops the W Series, artificial humans for special missions.

A key member of the <SRX Project>. A cheerful, friendly young robotics genius who has loved robots since childhood. After working on the Grungust series at the <Tesla Reich Institute>, he joined the <SRX Project>. He also made Burning PT, and often talks robots with Ryusei.
A <United Colony Corps> officer made a <DC> executive in the <DC War>. An anti-Federation devotee of Bian and Maier out to remake the world. Both cautious and bold.

A test pilot of <Project TD>, once run by the <DC> and now under Federation control. Single-minded and strong-willed, she dreams of becoming an astronaut and has endured grueling training to get there. Her skill falls far short of her Project TD comrade Sleigh, ranking her No. 04, but no one can match her passion.

A test pilot who leads the SRX Team. Gifted with Telekinesis, she was a test subject for her father at the Japan Special Brain Institute before enlisting. With the <SRX Project>'s launch she joined the military, helping develop the <T-LINK System>. Responsible and caring; outwardly tough, but a gentle woman who dislikes fighting. Rank Captain.

A member of the Federation's <Tactical Instructor Corps>. Upbeat and breezy, but serious at heart. From <The School>, he joined the DC remnants after the <L5 Campaign> and fought Kyosuke. After meeting Latune's group, he joined them.

A Shura who pilots the Gou-class Shura God Agares. Highly skilled, he once commanded lower Shura but gave up that post and now calls himself a "free warrior." An optimist who never broods, he has no real ambition and just enjoys the moment.
Spy under Strategist Mizar. A strong fighter with no gift for piloting <Shura Gods>, he feels inferior, but Mizar prizes his rare shapeshifting for spying. Cunning and cruel.

A Shura general, pilot of the Chou-class Shura God Maldict. Called "the Flash," he nearly rivals King Alkaid. Calm and fair, proud and loyal to his king, he still fears for a Shura life of only war and the realm's future. Fellow disciples Folka and Fernando see him as a brother; he taught them Kishin Ken.

Pilot at the Federation's Izu Base. Well-educated, glib and skilled, and a womanizer who'll flirt with any age. An ex-member of the special PTX Team and a first-rate pilot, he sees the big picture and won't shy from ruthless means. His father, Jonathan Kazahara, is a leader at the <Tesla Reich Institute> and co-creator of the Super Fighter Grungust. Rank Lieutenant.

Head of the SRX Team. Once a double agent for the <Aerogators>. A calm, intelligent woman. Taciturn, she seems cold but just shows no more emotion than needed. An infiltration expert, she also takes part in the <SRX Project>. Age unknown, rank Captain.

The Space Noah-class Hagane's bridge operator, in charge of sensors. Skilled, but flippant and always one word too many. <Before the DC War> he crewed the bridge of the first ship, Shirogane, which led Tetsuya to recommend him for the Hagane. Rank: Corporal.

A test pilot on the ATX Team. At heart she's cool and intelligent, but her self-promotion and flippant chatter hide it. She resents Kyosuke's curt treatment, yet loves him more than anyone. A skilled pilot, best at high-mobility and ranged combat. A heavy drinker who likes watching others get drunk. Rank: Second Lieutenant.
A woman warrior in Emmy Armor and pilot of the G-Thundergate, hostile to Fighter Roa. She is actually Shouko Azuma, mind-controlled by Duminas.

Head of the LTR (Lost Technology Research) special archaeology division, studying the Chokijin of ancient China. Flashy-looking but intelligent and composed. Her passion for research often blinds her to everything else, and she's prone to trouble.

Eldest son of the noble military Branstein family and Raidiese's older brother. Calm, proud, and devoted to a greater cause. A founding member of the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, he is a genius at piloting <Personal Trooper>s and <Armored Module>s. A flexible thinker, he always keeps the big picture in view. A keen rider, he names his machines Trombe (German for "tornado") after his beloved horse. A gourmet and a superb cook. He lost his wife, Katraia. Also known as Rätsel Feinschmecker.
A key <SRX Project> member and brilliant engineer, one of the fathers of the <Personal Trooper>. A cold perfectionist who oddly gets along with his opposite, Robert. Once married to Marion.

Cheerful and easygoing, if sloppy, hasty and a little rash; she never sweats the details. She loves putting younger girls, Latune above all, in makeup and bold outfits. After the <L5 Campaign> she left the army and married Giada.
A pilot on the Kurogane, Space Noah-class ship No. 3. Goes by Carla. A passionate, tomboyish girl. An optimist whose small worries vanish overnight.

Leader of the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, re-formed after the <L5 Campaign>. A field-first soldier risen from the ranks. Once feared as a demon, he's mellowed since. He and Latune's team make motion data and test new machines. Rank: Major.

A former member of the <DC> who took part in Dr. Wilhelm V. Jurgen's project. An <Armored Module> pilot, he served as test pilot for units fitted with the <AMN System> and the ODE System, and as an observer on unit operations. He shared Dr. Jurgen's ideals and sought to fulfill the mission of defending the Earth Sphere, but the project's cancellation set him on a path of gradual corruption.

Hiryu Custom pilot leading Octopus Squadron (Octo Team). Hot-blooded and combative, she acts before thinking, talks tough and often defies orders. Yet she's skilled and surprisingly caring to her subordinates. Rank: First Lieutenant.

Kota and Shoko's grandfather. Director of the Azuma Research Institute in Asakusa (though Shoko, who handles the books, is about the only staff it has). A hot-blooded man with a strong sense of justice. He looks after others and also chairs the neighborhood association. He always seems to be making useless inventions, but he is in fact a brilliant robotics scientist. Meeting Roa taught him of the evil forces targeting Earth, and he set about repairing the Compatible Kaiser that Roa brought. Once very wealthy from his many patents, he has poured most of his fortune into the Compatible Kaiser and its facilities. Age 68.

Leader of the ATX Team. Taciturn and seemingly cool, he just hides his feelings, burning quietly within. A gambler who thrives on long-odds bets. Excellen's lover; he rarely shows it, but treasures her above all. Rank: First Lieutenant.
ATX Team member. Gentle and quiet, yet remarkably decisive when it counts. A health-gadget fanatic who loves baths. A telekinetic, she pilots <T-LINK System> units. She and Bullet are a couple.
President of the Earth Federation Government. A hawkish politician who calls for all-out war against aliens. His looks and skill at backroom dealing earned him the nickname "Wizard."

Commander of Izu Base, Earth Federation Army Far East Command. A power-hungry officer who prefers to solve problems by force. Obsessed with his own achievements, he works his subordinates hard, so he is unpopular with those under him.

A high school student living in Asakusa, Japan. Grandson of local inventor Kisaburo Azuma. He comes off as blunt, but has a strong sense of justice. Quick to fight, loves festivals, spends freely, and cares deeply for his sister. Age 16.

An engineer at <Wong Heavy Industries> on the <Gestalt> development staff. Formerly with the <EOTI Institute> and the <DC>, he developed the <AMN System> and the ODE System under Dr. Wilhelm V. Jurgen.
Cheerful, flashy and wild-looking, but easygoing. Loves music. Garnet's boyfriend, but she calls the shots in private. After the <L5 Campaign>, he quit the army and married her.
Princess of the Principality of Riksent, a Federation enclave on the Mediterranean. Innocent, curious, impulsive. Latooni's friend; has a crush on Raidiese. Has Foresight.

A young genius scientist with ten-plus doctorates. Cool, brooding, handsome and supremely confident. Hates being used; never forgives those who use him. He did the Granzon's design and special gear for Dr. Bian Zoldark at the <EOTI Institute>, and is its test pilot. His identity and past are unknown.

Kota's sister. A cheerful, lively girl who can handle any housework. Friendly and popular at school. She always worries about Kota, but tends to nag him to his face. Compared with spendthrift Kota, she is thrifty to the point of stinginess. Age 15.

XO of the Hiryu Custom. A genteel Englishman of deep experience and wit who ably supports Lefina. Formerly XO of the deep-space explorer Hiryu under Daitetsu. Meant to succeed Daitetsu when he was relieved over the Hiryu's damage, he instead recommended Lefina as captain. Drinks hard like Daitetsu; knows his Western spirits. Rank: Lieutenant Commander.

Director of the <Tesla Reich Institute>. Irm's father and Robert's former boss. An authority on robotics whose talent rivals Bian Zoldark's in his prime. Yet he's easygoing, a joker and a womanizer. He also created the Gurungust series.

A <Project TD> test pilot. Younger sister of project head Filio Presty, whom she adores; she tests the Series 77 to realize his dream. As Number 01, the project's top pilot, she is fierce and merciless toward any foe, supremely confident in her skill and deeply proud.

A member of the Earth Federation Army <Tactical Instructor Corps>. A graduate of <The School>, she is partnered with Arado. A serious honor-student type, strong-willed and short-tempered. She jumps to conclusions and is scary when angry, but is caring at heart and always worries about her partner Arado.
A woman who developed the <AMN System> and the ODE System alongside Kyle, Gigi and others. Originally a gifted researcher in Dr. Wilhelm V. Jurgen's lab, she joined the project at his request.
A bold warrior who stays true to his beliefs. He values honor and fair play, but can be inflexible. An expert in melee, especially swordplay. Rank: Major.

A member of Project Ark (the species preservation plan) and developer of Magus, the <Earth Cradle>'s control computer. A rational realist whose beauty adds to an aloof air, yet she is kind and caring at heart.

A Hiryu Custom pilot in Katina's Octopus Squad (Octo Team). A carefree optimist and self-styled gambler who loves contests and always tests his luck. Easygoing, but quick-witted and perceptive. Deft with his hands and good at magic tricks, but hopeless at sports. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

Chief of <Project TD>'s system development team. After the <DC>'s fall, she carries on Project TD under Federation military control with Filio, Sleigh and Ibis. She supports Filio at work and in private, and understands him well. Caring, personable and dependable, she can still make coldly rational calls.
A mysterious girl who pilots a small mobile weapon called the "Teugatel." Cheerful, lively and competitive. She carries out orders from someone...
A mysterious girl who pilots a mobile weapon called the "Eleos." She strikes others as quiet and timid. She carries out orders from someone...

Captain of the Hagane, second Space Noah-class multipurpose battleship. Matured through combat in the <DC War> and <L5 Campaign>, he succeeded Daitetsu Minase, killed in the <Inspector Incident>, as captain. Rank: Major.
Picked by President Bryan Midcrid as his aide after the <L5 Campaign>. Well connected in politics and business, but his past is a mystery.
An Excellence test pilot. Raul's twin sister. Strong-willed and cheerful, and steadier than Raul, she's often mistaken for the older twin. Loves a challenge and won't budge once she's spoken. Age 18.

Head of <Project TD>. A former <DC> roboticist who laid the groundwork for the Lion series. After its fall, he carried on under Federation military control, but it pains him that Series 77 serves military ends. His gentle, earnest nature and talent win him many friends.

A Shura, a warrior from another world, piloting the Gou-class Shura God Birefall. Like Folka he uses Kishin Ken, at nearly equal skill. Combative and always on edge, he cares little beyond fighting and couldn't grasp Folka's budding doubts about the Shura. Raised like twins while training together, they were good rivals, but since Folka spared him in a death match before the Shura King, Fernando burns with rage at the humiliation.

A Shura, a warrior from another world, master of the Shura martial art Kishin Ken and pilot of the Gou-class Shura God Ialdabaoth. Among the top Shura, he and Fernando were tipped as future generals. Yet he doubts a Shura way that forces friends to duel to the death under the law. Quiet and reserved off the battlefield, he finds ordinary life outside the Shura realm new, and asks questions frankly, like a child. He grew up like family with fellow trainees Fernando and Altis, and still sees Altis as a brother.

ATX Team test pilot, nicknamed Bullet. An earnest, loyal young man with a strong sense of justice. Often dragged along by the reckless Kyosuke and Excellen. Has an aptitude for Telekinesis and pilots <T-LINK System> units. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

New member of the SRX Team. Aya Kobayashi's sister, on record as killed in an accident. Quiet and gentle, she has no memory of her past. Found after the <L5 Campaign>, she recovered under her father Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi before joining as a trainee.

Head of the Earth Federation Army's next mainstay unit trials. In collusion with Rick Wong and <Isurugi Heavy Industries>, he is pulling strings to get the <Gestalt> adopted as the next mainstay unit.

A Shura general, pilot of the Chou-class Shura God Andras. Called "Heavy Quake," taken from Mizar's title "Great Quake." He lives to crush the weak; his childlike cruelty and huge strength have slain many Shura.

Pilot of Cybuster, Masou Kishin of wind. Impulsive, just and athletic, but hopelessly bad with directions. A Japanese youth summoned to Langran in the underworld La Gias to pilot Cybuster and stop a prophesied demon god's calamity.
Central figure of the <ATX Project>. A gifted scientist, but a jealous, attention-hungry workaholic. Developer of Alteisen and Weissritter, now building new prototypes at <Mao Industries>.

Shura strategist, pilot of the Chou-class Shura God Glasyalabolas. Called "Great Quake," he is a fine fighter and a brilliant mind, alone in charge of unraveling the Tenku Majo's technology, far beyond the Shura. Loyal to King Alkaid since his rise to conquest, though his true aims are unknown.

One of the Exaland's developers. A mechanic who handles all upkeep and new frame design. Earnest and hardworking, yet insecure that mechanics is all she can do. Pained that the Exaland, built for rescue work, is used for war.

President of <Isurugi Heavy Industries>. Daughter of ex-president Renji Isurugi, who died in the <L5 Campaign>. Soft-spoken and gentle-looking, but truly shrewd: profit comes first, by any means and with any partner.
Mercenary who pilots the Shishioh Blade-armed Guarlion Custom "Mumyou." An ace pilot and master swordsman living to "cut" men and machines. Age 45.

A Shura general, pilot of the Chou-class Shura God Peirines. True to her title "Ice Lance," she is calm, strict, and ruthless to foes, but kind to her admirers; with her beauty, this earns her many Shura devotees. Altis's right hand, she quietly cherishes feelings for him.

A pilot attached to the Kurogane, third Space Noah-class multipurpose battleship. Calm and collected, he always strives to act as a gentleman. He despises dirty tactics and never hesitates to help the weak. A tea lover, he is particular about how it is brewed and drunk.

A scientist who developed the <AMN System> and the ODE System, network systems for humanoid mobile weapons, first at the <EOTI Institute> and then the <DC>. Gentle by nature, he was greatly respected by his staff. But an accident during testing ended his project, and the ODE System was buried. Jurgen left the DC in despair, and later lost his beloved family in an <Aerogators> attack.
Bridge operator of the Hiryu Custom. Serious and a bit of a neat freak, but personable. A classmate of Lefina's at the space academy, she always watches over her. Rank: Corporal.
Operator for the Time Flow Engine. A young researcher seeking "infinite energy anyone can use." Ignores what bores him but throws himself into what interests him, often blind to all else.

A <Mao Industries> staff member, now on loan to the Earth Federation Army <Tactical Instructor Corps> in various support roles. A thoughtful, quiet woman with telepathic abilities, she worked on man-machine interface development at Mao Industries. Her specialty is yoga, and she is somewhat feared for recommending difficult asanas (yoga poses) to others.
SRX Team test pilot. From the Branstein family of noted soldiers. Calm and highly skilled. A bit sardonic, yet loyal and passionate at heart. Rank: Second Lieutenant.

Exaland test pilot. Responsible and hot-blooded, he doesn't fuss over details. His father is Fel, a Time Flow Engine researcher. For years he trained with his twin sister Fiona to become an Exaland test pilot. But keeping Time Flow Engine development alive required military funding, so he set out to finish the engine-powered Exaland and prove its worth. Age 18.
A Hiryu Custom pilot and Katina's direct subordinate. Gentle and quiet, he tries to rein in the reckless Katina. Always backing others up, on duty or off, he's the unsung hero.

A pilot in the <Tactical Instructor Corps>, re-formed after the <L5 Campaign>. From <The School>, she excels at piloting Personal Troopers and combat. Brutal School experiments closed her heart; meeting Ryusei's group restored her humanity.

Member of the Earth Federation Army's <Tactical Instructor Corps>. A skilled fighter and pilot, mechanically calm, she is a bright, quiet beauty with an inhuman air. Really a "W Series" artificial human and once a Shadow Mirror spy, she found a self after meeting Kyosuke's group. She now leads Arado, Seolla, and others in the Corps.
A mysterious boy piloting the Hypocrisis. Gentle and kind, he gives off a calm air. He is carrying out someone's orders, but...

A cheerful, earnest girl with a strong sense of justice. A sore loser, she speaks her mind when sure she's right, yet admits mistakes others point out. Her father Yuan is an executive at <Mao Industries>.
Advisor to the <Tesla Reich Institute>. A Jigen-ryu master, he designs Grungust swords and sword motions, and taught Sänger and Brit. Strict about the sword, but otherwise a kindly old man.
President of <Wong Heavy Industries>. Ambitious, he hired Gigi and others from the old <EOTI Institute> and <DC> to develop the <Gestalt>.
SRX Team test pilot. Hot-blooded, reckless and a super robot fanatic. Childish, yet one of the team's strongest wills, and a psychokinetic. Second Lieutenant.
Only daughter of <DC> leader Bian Zoldark. Superhuman athleticism, reflexes and vision. A beauty, but a wild tomboy who's weak to flattery. Loves obscure Japanese period dramas. Hobby: saving money.
A shy, gentle boy prone to pessimism. He's bad at expressing his feelings and hates himself for it. His love of tinkering with machines led him to help develop a new Personal Trooper.

A mystery man who secretly aids the Hagane and Hiryu Custom. Calm, proud and devoted to a greater cause, yet flexible, always acting with the big picture in view. A genius pilot, he names every machine after his beloved horse Trombe (German for "tornado"). A gourmet and a superb cook.

A Hiryu Custom pilot in Katina's Octopus Team (Octo Squad). Of the Garstein family, a Branstein branch house, she's cousin to Rai and Elzam. Cool, proud and strong-willed, she keeps people at a distance, but always putting on a brave front, she's secretly weak to sympathy. Seemingly good at everything, she can't cook. Second Lieutenant.

Captain of the Hiryu-class Hiryu Custom. She graduated top of her class from the Icarus Base space academy in the asteroid belt. Demure, a worrier and quick to tears, but strong inside. Though new, her earnest dedication has won the crew's trust. Chosen on Sean's recommendation, she grows into a true captain with his support. Commander.
A mysterious warrior from another world. His body was lost in battle, so he moved his soul into the crystal on the Roa Armor. When Kota dons the Roa Armor, their minds link and he gives sound advice.

A key member of the <SRX Project>. A cheerful, friendly young robotics genius who has loved robots since childhood. After working on the Grungust series at the <Tesla Reich Institute>, he joined the <SRX Project>. He also made Burning PT, and often talks robots with Ryusei.
A <United Colony Corps> officer made a <DC> executive in the <DC War>. An anti-Federation devotee of Bian and Maier out to remake the world. Both cautious and bold.

The Shura King. Once king of Ra, a nation of the Shura realm, he led mighty Shura in wars on other nations to conquer the realm. When a great cataclysm struck, he led the survivors to flee into the Swordian, or Tenku Majo, which appeared by chance. As if guided, it shifted to the Earth Sphere, and Alkaid set out to make Earth a new Shura realm. Ra picks rulers by strength; Alkaid won the throne by defeating the last king. Bold and fierce, he embodies the Law of the Shura, "obey the strong," and many Shura revere him. Battle is his reason to live and his greatest joy, yet he seems to await the young Shura who will one day defeat him.

An officer of the Earth Federation Army's Intelligence Division. Calm, composed and sharp-witted, with something mysterious about him, yet he has a soft spot for duty and compassion. A veteran of the Federation's <Tactical Instructor Corps>, which created the base data for the <TC-OS>, he is a top-class Personal Trooper pilot. Age 27 (self-reported). Rank: Major.

Masaki's familiar. A spirit formed from a piece of his subconscious; she doesn't resemble him in personality because she is one of his personas. She rides in the Cybuster with Masaki and supports him. Fairly laid-back, but more of a worrier, she often scolds the reckless Shiro and Masaki.

Masaki's familiar, split off from part of his unconscious. It differs from him because it's one of his personas. Rides in Cybuster to support him. Fairly laid-back, yet competitive and always has one word too many.
A pilot cadet training on <PT>s at Aviano Base. Cheerful, if a bit scatterbrained. She is Erde Mitte's student, and Aqua respects her.

Ex-leader of <Shadow Mirror>'s special disposal squad. A fine pilot and fighter, cool but hot-blooded within. In his own world, Kyosuke Nanbu gained a strange power, and he saw Kyosuke and his Gespenst Mk-III as a threat; foreseeing this world's Kyosuke would gain the same, he tried to kill him. Defeated in the final battle inside the <White Star> late in the <Inspector Incident>, he was left near death, then recovered with his Soulgain by the Cry Wolves, the Earth Federation Army's 3rd Special Ops PT Unit.

A girl, the only <Einst> with a near-human form. A clone-like being built from Excellen Browning's data, she resembles her in face and voice. She fought Kyosuke's group often in the <Inspector Incident>, but, drawn to the "power of human feelings," finally sided with them against Einst leader Stern Neu Regiseia.

Leader of the Earth Federation Army's 3rd Special Ops <PT> Unit, the Cry Wolves. Rank: Major. A strict, dutiful soldier and skilled pilot. He saw talent in Hugo Medio and his son Foglia Est and trains them hard. To Foglia he is a superior, not a father, and never mixes the two.
A brilliant scientist formerly of the <EOTI Institute>, now developing new mobile weapons for the Tsentr Project. Also one of Granzon's designers.
AI researcher and creator of the advanced combat AI, AI0 (AI Zero).
A nice guy working part-time every day.
A man-machine interface researcher with the Tsentr Project, involved in developing the Wendigo.

Member of the Earth Federation Army's 3rd Special Ops <PT> Unit, the Cry Wolves. Rank: Warrant Officer. Having faced poverty since childhood, he clings fiercely to life. Moody, but usually quiet. A Cry Wolves rookie, but a skilled pilot. Close with Foglia Est, his partner on missions.

Member of the Earth Federation Army's 3rd Special Ops <PT> Unit, the Cry Wolves. Rank: Warrant Officer. Son of leader Albero Est. Easygoing; a rookie, but a skilled pilot. Often too eager to impress his father.
Head of the Tsentr Project. Knowing he uses the military for his research just as it uses him, he quietly pursues a project of his own.
Federation Army Incirlik Base commander.
